rawPayload.Product_Description_Legacy: This 30-inch gas range features advanced Air Cooking Technology designed to improve cooking performance and convenience. Enjoy crispy results faster with No Preheat Air Fry, and achieve consistent results across multiple racks with Air Baking, which uses dynamic airflow for even heat distribution. With multiple cooking modes and a powerful 12,000 BTU Griddle Zone, this range expands your cooking possibilities while making it easy to prepare a wide variety of meals. A self-cleaning oven also helps simplify maintenance.
rawPayload.Features_Legacy:
• Air Cooking Technology – Dynamic airflow and intense heat deliver crisp, even results with advanced Air Fry and Air Baking functions.
  • No Preheat Air Fry – Save up to 10 minutes with this advanced air fry mode that delivers fast, crispy results for foods like chicken wings and mozzarella sticks without preheating.
  • Air Baking – A high-speed fan optimizes airflow and circulates consistent heat throughout the oven, ensuring even baking on multiple racks for breads, pastries, and more.
  • Griddle Zone – A powerful 12,000 BTU oval burner provides a larger cooking area, perfect for preparing multiple foods at once.
  • SpeedHeat™ Burner – Boil up to 20% faster with high heat, helping you get meals on the table quicker.
  • 6 Cooking Modes – Includes No Preheat Air Fry, Air Baking, No Preheat Mode, Bake, Broil, and Keep Warm for versatile cooking options.
  • Self Clean – Adjustable self-clean cycle helps remove baked-on spills and splatters with minimal effort.
  • Edge-to-Edge Cast-Iron Grates – Provides a large cooking surface and allows cookware to move easily across burners.
  • No Preheat Mode – Start cooking right away without waiting for the oven to preheat; the oven automatically adjusts cooking time for items like frozen pizzas.
  • Cooktop Flexibility – Multiple burner sizes and power levels make it easy to cook several dishes simultaneously.
  • Sabbath Mode – Keeps the oven in Bake mode for extended cooking or warming while disabling other functions.
  • Fingerprint-Resistant Stainless Steel – Durable finish resists smudges and fingerprints for easy cleaning.
  • Large Capacity Oven (5.0 cu. ft.) – Spacious interior accommodates large dishes such as a full-sized turkey, perfect for family meals and entertaining.

product.description:
Get the ultimate in Air Cooking Technology and bring fresh options to family dinner with this 30-inch, High Speed Preheat 5.3 cu. ft. gas range. Clean with just water, not harsh cleaners, with WipeClean™ coating, the easiest to clean electric cooktop coating.* Get crispy and save time with No Preheat Air Fry, and go from gooey to golden and bake evenly on multiple racks with Air Baking. Plus, you can stay on top of the latest cooking features and unlock new ones over time with Smart Feature Updates. *When compared with uncoated cooktop with same heating technology and similar wattages.

Features:

  • 5.3 cu. ft. capacity meets the needs of today's busy homes
  • This range comes equipped with 5 sealed burners
  • Touch controls are precise and easy to use
  • Range includes viewing window, broil element, and storage drawer
  • Easily cook multiple dishes at once with a flexible cooktop that offers a range of element sizes and power levels
  • Easily clean your oven with the adjustable Self Clean cycle that can be customized based on the amount of spills and splatters
  • Enjoy plenty of space to sauté?, boil and simmer with Edge-to-Edge Cast-Iron Grates and the flexibility of a cooktop with a range of burner sizes and power levels
  • Covered under a 1 year limited parts and labor manufacturer warranty

Product Technologies:

  • Air Baking: Go from gooey to golden and get even results when baking on multiple racks with Air Baking. Whirlpool's high-speed fan optimizes air flow and drives consistent heat throughout the oven. Get golden results on breads, pastries and more.
  • Air Cooking Technology: Experience the Difference* with more air flow with No Preheat Air Fry and Air Baking
    *Compared to thermal bake
  • Cooking Modes: Take your favorite meals from fresh, fridge or freezer to fabulous with No Preheat Air Fry mode, Air Baking, Bake, Broil and Keep Warm
  • Griddle Zone: Bring a whole new world of cooking capabilities to your cooktop with the 12,000 BTU Griddle Zone. One long, oval-shaped burner makes it easy to cook up all that delights, all at once
  • No Preheat Mode: Take preheating off your plate with No Preheat Mode. Simply place your food in the oven and start baking. The oven will adjust the cook time for frozen pizzas and more.
  • SpeedHeat™ Burner: Use the SpeedHeat Burner to boil 20% faster* with high heat, so you can get dinner to the table quickly (*compared to 9.5K burner on the same model)
  • Smart Range: When you’re busy elsewhere, use your smartphone to get dinner started by remotely preheating the oven. Or, when your hands are full, use your compatible voice-enabled device to adjust the cook time or temperature with a voice command.*

    *Appliance must be set to remote enable. WiFi & App Required. Features subject to change. Details and privacy info at whirlpool.com/connect

Specifications:

  • Total Capacity: 5.3 Cu. Ft.
  • Back Left Burner BTU: 10,000
  • Back Right Burner BTU: 5,000
  • Front Left Burner BTU: 15,000
  • Front Right Burner BTU: 18,000
  • Broil Element: Yes
  • Convection: No
  • Self Cleaning: Yes
  • Depth: 28"
  • Height: 47-7/8"
  • Width: 29-7/8"
